analysis.problem_hypothesis: Callback and booking enquiries may need manual qualification by repair type, city, urgency, and missing details
analysis.solution: Enquiry-qualification automation for callback and booking enquiries without requiring a new consumer mobile app
analysis.processing: Automated qualification of callback and booking enquiries based on predefined criteria for repair type, city, urgency, and missing details
analysis.business_value: Reduces manual qualification time, improves accuracy of enquiry handling, and increases conversion rates for callback and booking by automating the qualification process
